crossRefs.note: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of…
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over…
Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.

translations.web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
translations.bsb: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
translations.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
translations.asv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.
